acceptance_criteria: In the damaged, no-active and empty-profile states and when no concept of a profile can be loaded, the example concepts are tappable and a German notice says they are examples and why
A profile board whose catalogue later changes or drops a chosen concept still shows and speaks the wording stored when it was chosen
The child's display name is not rendered on the board
After a profile change the controller re-mounts the board from the same store instance without reloading the page
A late start-up answer that equals the mounted view causes no re-mount
approved_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
goal: Foundations for the caregiver area: the board has its own container, one app controller owns the single ProfileStore instance and can re-resolve and re-mount the board after a profile change; when a child's own board cannot be shown the labelled example concepts are shown with a clear German notice; choosing a catalogue concept copies its wording into the profile; the child's name is not on the child-facing board; index.html has a static line for failed script loading.
non_goals: No caregiver screens, no gesture to reach them, no profile creation UI (NG-13)
No change to the export format
planned_by: Lars Moelleken (delegated to Claude for this session)
